name: Air conditioning production line solution
summary: A whole-line automation solution for air conditioning indoor and outdoor unit manufacturers, achieving high-takt, high-quality mass production.
contentHtml:
The air conditioning production line solution is a whole-line automation solution provided by TXAM for air conditioning indoor and outdoor unit manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The whole line covers the entire process including heat exchanger assembly, pipeline connection, vacuum extraction, refrigerant charging, helium leak detection, electrical wiring, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise heat exchanger assembly ensures heat exchange efficiency
  • Automated pipeline system significantly reduces leakage rate
  • High-precision charging system ensures accurate refrigerant charging
  • Helium mass spectrometry leak detection offers high sensitivity for sealing tests
  • Fast multi-model switching with short changeover time
  • High degree of whole-line automation for high production capacity and efficiency

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
